name: 08823 · Franklin Park, NJ
findings: ZIP 08823 (Franklin Park) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08823 (Franklin Park) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
